explicit_non_claims: Does not claim causal validity, successful execution, adequate power, reproducibility, or backend behavioral equivalence.
profile.intended_claim: The scenario is bound to a pre-run design with controlled variation, allocation, apparatus, timing, capture, and analysis intent.

required_concerns.binding_obligation: The scenario and run must reference the same apparatus requirement and realized context identities.
required_concerns.definition: Scientific claims bind to declared apparatus requirements and realized context.
required_concerns.limitation: Apparatus constraints/context scope claims to a realization; they do not guarantee availability.
required_concerns.title: Apparatus constraints and context

required_concerns.definition: Preconditions, invariants, and postconditions reference propositions with explicit polarity.
required_concerns.limitation: Assertion composition is not evaluator lifecycle success or graded scoring.
required_concerns.title: Role-constrained assertions

required_concerns.definition: Authored intent, realized state, observation, and evidence remain distinct claim planes.

evidence.claim: Defines authored, observed, and evidence planes.

required_concerns.limitation: Plane separation exists across contracts, but the SDL boundary audit and authored-to-observed binding remain open.
required_concerns.title: Authored and observed state separation

required_concerns.definition: Realizers disclose and execute bounded resource cleanup and reconciliation.

evidence.claim: Runtime-owned startup reconciliation and linked administrative resolution of indeterminate operations.

required_concerns.limitation: RAES reconciles operations whose effects are unknown, but native teardown belongs to backend distributions (ADR-115). Portable authored cleanup and cross-backend reconciliation guarantees are incomplete.
required_concerns.title: Backend teardown and reconciliation

required_concerns.definition: Conformance, refinement, trace, observational, bisimulation, epistemic, and strategic relations are not conflated.

evidence.claim: Normative relation definitions, dimensions, claim surfaces, assurance states, and counterexamples.
Published closed contract for the revisioned taxonomy.
Backend conformance reports disclose bounded-probe relation, projection, case boundary, and nonclaims.
Catalog, binding, counterexample, and property-based relation tests.
Cross-field report validation binding relation, quantifier, evidence scope, claimed case set, and execution basis before serialization or persistence.
Claim-surface conflation audit and remediation record.
Finite divergence-preserving branching-bisimulation check boundary, subject identity, and nonclaims for participant-crossing-dpbb-finite-v1@rev2.
Complete-carrier, mutation, source-drift, and claim-promotion refusals for the finite model-check result.
The pinned qualified reproduction joins its measurement, execution record, and separate implementation-agent review to the pinned model-check subject.
Published participant-crossing facts and claim equal the admitted model-check and reproduction records.

required_concerns.limitation: The revisioned taxonomy, bindings, finite-evidence gate, and counterexamples are implemented. One reproduced finite model-check result relates the declared initial states over the complete participant-crossing-dpbb-finite-v1@rev2 carrier only; universal simulation, refinement, equivalence, bisimulation, epistemic, strategic, probabilistic, timed, and partial-order proofs remain deliberately unproved or future.
required_concerns.title: Behavioral relation taxonomy

required_concerns.definition: Clock identity, origin, rate, and ownership are declared.
required_concerns.limitation: Clock context exists outside SDL, but portable clock identity/origin/rate authoring is incomplete.
required_concerns.title: Clock declaration

required_concerns.definition: Authored fields conform to the published closed SDL document model.
required_concerns.limitation: Closed structure permits a name-only fragment and is not a completeness claim.
required_concerns.title: Closed structural model

required_concerns.definition: Executable probes are bindings and do not redefine proposition truth.

evidence.claim: Backend binding capability and rejection coverage.

required_concerns.limitation: Conditions are probe realizations and cannot substitute command success for truth.
required_concerns.semantic_owner: SDL conditions and runtime truth results
required_concerns.title: Condition-to-proposition binding

required_concerns.binding_obligation: The authoring allocation must bind to study membership and condition assignments for the same scenario-derived run set.
required_concerns.definition: Conditions, blocking factors, assignment units, and replication allocation are declared.

evidence.claim: Archived study allocation and membership coverage.

required_concerns.limitation: Allocation is an experiment/study concern and does not alter SDL meaning.
required_concerns.title: Controlled allocation

required_concerns.definition: Intentional scenario identities and credential posture are distinct from operator secrets.
required_concerns.limitation: Account and runtime-value posture exists, but authored credential-bearing setup remains unresolved.
required_concerns.title: Credential intent

required_concerns.definition: Deadlines, evaluation windows, and temporal bounds use declared time domains.
required_concerns.limitation: Objective windows exist, but a complete time-domain-bound deadline surface is not published.
required_concerns.title: Deadlines and windows

required_concerns.binding_obligation: Evaluation outcomes must bind to evidence, derived measures, the admitted scenario identity, and the same run provenance.
required_concerns.definition: Outcome interpretation, measures, evidence, and evaluation results retain provenance.
required_concerns.limitation: Outcome records preserve evidence and interpretation; they do not by themselves prove scientific validity.
required_concerns.title: Evaluation outcome evidence

required_concerns.binding_obligation: Evidence and associated artifacts must bind semantic bytes, parent identity, capture context, and derivation provenance for the same run.
required_concerns.definition: Captured evidence, measures, artifacts, and derivations remain attributable and integrity-bound.

evidence.claim: Associated artifact integrity and parent binding.

required_concerns.limitation: Evidence provenance supports audit and derivation; it does not turn authored requirements into captured evidence.
required_concerns.title: Evidence provenance

required_concerns.binding_obligation: The completeness bundle must bind the instantiated scenario identity to an experiment authoring input whose declared factors govern the run plan.
required_concerns.definition: Controlled factors and levels are declared separately from scenario substitution.

evidence.claim: Published experiment factor and level contract.

required_concerns.limitation: Factors belong to experiment authoring, not Scenario.
required_concerns.title: Experimental factor declaration

required_concerns.definition: CPU architecture and host-level compatibility requirements are portable constraints.
required_concerns.limitation: Node lacks a portable host CPU architecture constraint.
required_concerns.title: Host architecture constraints

required_concerns.definition: Advancement, pacing, synchronization, and drift policy are explicit.
required_concerns.limitation: Participant time-management records exist; general advancement and synchronization semantics remain open.
required_concerns.title: Pacing and synchronization

required_concerns.definition: Scenario parameters have typed finite or constrained domains and portable bindings.
required_concerns.limitation: SDL variables instantiate scenario values; they do not define an experimental factor design.
required_concerns.title: Parameter typing

required_concerns.definition: Claims over stable subjects use typed backend-neutral predicates and evidence bases.
required_concerns.limitation: The model defines claims and truth domains; it does not guarantee a backend can decide them.
required_concerns.title: Backend-neutral propositions

required_concerns.binding_obligation: The run plan must name the randomization control and preserve it into apparatus and run evidence.
required_concerns.definition: Random assignment or sampling policy and its scope are declared.
required_concerns.limitation: A policy reference records the mechanism; it does not prove unbiased execution.
required_concerns.title: Randomization policy

required_concerns.binding_obligation: The run plan must bind its scenario input, factors, allocation, stochastic controls, and episode intent before execution.
required_concerns.definition: Pre-run episode, stochastic, allocation, and stopping intent is versioned.
required_concerns.limitation: Run planning is an experiment authoring concern and is not embedded in Scenario.
required_concerns.title: Run plan

required_concerns.definition: Exact, constrained, and open realization posture is explicit at the governed scope.
required_concerns.limitation: Realization envelopes and explicitness semantics exist, but scenario-scoped default and most-specific override authority remain open.
required_concerns.title: Scoped specificity and open-world intent

required_concerns.binding_obligation: Every relevant pre-run stochastic control must resolve to the apparatus/run record or disclose why no seed applies.
required_concerns.definition: Relevant seed, generator, scheduler, and sampling controls are preserved with provenance.
required_concerns.limitation: Seed preservation supports reproduction attempts but is not a reproducibility proof.
required_concerns.title: Seed preservation

required_concerns.definition: Named references and cross-section constraints pass semantic validation.
required_concerns.limitation: Semantic admission covers declared SDL references, not backend realization.
required_concerns.title: Semantic reference integrity

required_concerns.definition: Source uses the governed SDL YAML profile and safe loading rules.

evidence.claim: Safe YAML ingress and source-profile enforcement.

required_concerns.limitation: Admission proves the governed source profile, not scientific adequacy.
required_concerns.title: Canonical SDL source profile

required_concerns.binding_obligation: The study must bind included runs, allocation, research questions, analysis plan, and validity limitations to the same scenario lineage.
required_concerns.definition: Study questions, membership, allocation, analysis plan, and validity notes are archived.
required_concerns.limitation: A conforming study record preserves design and membership but does not establish adequate analysis or generalizability.
required_concerns.title: Study and benchmark record

required_concerns.binding_obligation: The scenario snapshot must bind to apparatus constraints and a backend realization envelope that discloses unsupported requirements.
required_concerns.definition: Backend, hypervisor, container, network, and apparatus constraints are explicit.

evidence.claim: Apparatus constraint and realized context contract.

required_concerns.limitation: Substrate constraints are apparatus and realization requirements, not universal SDL fields.
required_concerns.title: Substrate constraints

required_concerns.definition: Ordering, causality, concurrency, and partial-order claims have governed semantics.
required_concerns.limitation: Workflow and participant records preserve bounded order, but general causal and partial-order SDL semantics remain open.
required_concerns.title: Temporal ordering and causality

required_concerns.definition: Wall, monotonic, logical, simulation, and scenario time domains are explicit.
required_concerns.limitation: Experiment and participant contracts carry bounded time context; the SDL time-domain authoring model remains incomplete.
required_concerns.title: Time-domain declaration

required_concerns.definition: Scenario topology, resources, services, identities, and relationships are authored as intent.

evidence.claim: Typed scenario topology and resource surfaces.

required_concerns.limitation: The SDL expresses intent; realizability remains apparatus and backend relative.
required_concerns.title: Topology and resource intent

required_concerns.definition: Verifier, judge, annotation, disagreement, and adjudication assets are governed.
required_concerns.limitation: Portable verifier, judge, annotation, disagreement, and adjudication contracts remain planned.
required_concerns.title: Verifier and adjudication
